solace.name: Solace
solace.config.title: Solace
solace.mysolace.hint: Your own Solace settings. Changes apply when you press Save, the same as running the /solace commands; the server has the final say on capped features and permissions.
solace.config.allow_self_service.tooltip: If off, only operators can use /solace.
solace.config.pacifist.tooltip: Solace players cannot deal damage to mobs or players.
solace.config.allow_multiple_players.too: If off, only one player may have Solace enabled at a time.
solace.config.protection.mode.tooltip: Which explosions may break blocks. Home region uses /solace home set.
solace.config.protection.home_radius.too: Protected radius around the home (home region mode only).
solace.config.remote.heading: Configured on the server
solace.config.remote.body: These settings live on the server you're connected to, so this screen can't change them from here. An operator can adjust them in-game with /solace commands, or by editing config/solace.json on the server. This editor is available at the title screen and when you host the world yourself.
